decision.name: NARROW_TWO_WRITER_GENERATION_TO_REAL_SINGLE_HANDOFF_STALE_OVERWRITE
decision.finding: Anata-facing cf-anata-handoff-v1 is one anata_latest.json artifact, not a transactional three-file read. Yet runner.run_once computes anata_handoff from a locked archive snapshot and later writes anata_latest.json without a publication lock or generation check. A paused older run can overwrite a newer completed run's single valid handoff. Even identical as_of_ms clocks can conceal economically different snapshots. This is source-derived; not executed or observed in production.
decision.why_improved: Unlike the old triple-file atomicity oracle, this checks only the documented consumer file and requires a semantic source_evidence witness. Existing test_atomic_handoff_visibility checks complete JSON per os.replace, not monotonic publication order.
no_network_test_contract: Test-only overlay part2/capital_flow/tests/test_runner_single_handoff_stale.py in an authorized disposable exact-SHA checkout. No production edits, no network, no sleeps as ordering oracle.

Use fixed T=1800000060000 and tmp_path. Spawn child A with mp.get_context('spawn') and a top-level worker function; A runs runner.run_once(local_dir=tmp_path,network=False,external_jsonl=(),as_of_ms=T) on initially empty archive. Patch runner.atomic_write_json inside child A only: when path.name=='anata_latest.json', capture a deep copy of payload, set A_ready Event, wait release_A Event (bounded 10 s), then call original atomic_write_json.

Parent waits A_ready (bounded), verifies no anata_latest.json from A has yet been published, then appends one valid BTC ETF scoring FlowObservation to the same archive (source_record_id=rowB; effective/available/observed <= T), runs B runner.run_once with same T/network=False/external_jsonl=(), and records B anata_output and persisted anata_latest.json. B must complete before release_A.

Semantic preflight: A captured source_evidence has no rowB; B source_evidence includes rowB; B archive_records_loaded=1 and persisted anata_latest.json equals B anata_output. Do not accept JSON hash differences caused only by source path or collection_attempts.

In finally release_A, join child with bounded timeout and terminate only if needed; assert exitcode=0 and collect A result. Re-read anata_latest.json. Required monotonic publication acceptance: final file must remain B anata_output, never stale A payload. Current code predicts final==A (RED), not executed. Assert JSON parse validity, archive exactly one original row, and run C sequentially as positive control.

Run python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests/test_runner_single_handoff_stale.py; python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests/test_archive_concurrent_dedup.py part2/capital_flow/tests/test_archive_reader_writer_visibility.py; python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests. Record exact SHA, exit codes, non-skipped counts, stdout/stderr and overlay hash.
